plainTranslation: Composite Pluto in the 7 House: With Composite Pluto in the 7th house, you may struggle over power and control of the relationship. You may each want to force your own ideas of how the relationship should be on the other, and you need to be more open and respectful. The relationship can serve to transform each of you, but you have to remember to treat each other with respect and equality, otherwise you just have drama.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
note: Imported from The Dark Pixie Astrology composites material text.
